in_sanskrit.name: चन्दना
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The fragrant powder derived from the heartwood of the sandal tree, used for religious rituals, perfumes, and cosmetics.

in_marathi.name: Chandana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'chandana', meaning 'sandalwood'. In Hindu mythology, sandalwood is considered sacred and is often used in religious rituals and for making idols.
